decision_log.decision: Scope: public Python tool, five tests, Excel output.
CSV with five required and three optional columns (Q1).
Duplicate: same account, amount and date (Q2); round: multiple of 1000 (Q3).
Weekends plus holidays from an optional CSV (Q4); gaps over distinct numbers (Q5).
Benford: MAD, first digit, minimum of 1000 rows (Q6, Q7).
MIT licence; Excel with XlsxWriter; Python 3.11 or later and CI on 3.11 and 3.14.
Word report outside v1, optional final unit.
Architecture and CSV format approved (Q15); stack approved (Q17).
Generator outside the public repository, in a private project, with small files in tests/fixtures (Q16).
Minimum of 1000 rows and default base 1000, recorded as assumptions.
Accepted all 11 open recommendations: repeated entry_id, decimals, decimal comma, empty file, Benford alert level, overwrite, runtime, encoding, text length, holidays format, fixture size.
Approved the plain-language summary of the specification network (2026-11-05); files marked decided; network unverified because the official checker is unavailable.
Strict ASCII formats for numbers and dates, with no trimming.
File structure rules: extra columns, field counts, empty file, repeated column, multi-line source_row, holidays BOM and repeats.
Excel writing rules: write_string, computed formula values, text cut at the cell limit, atomic replace, locked file is code 1.
Versions pinned in constraints.txt with python_version markers, replacing a plain pip freeze; the four dependencies stay.
ground_truth.csv gains document_number, so the recall test can match gaps and Benford.
Added the missing visible strings and the sheet layout; Benford small-sample caveat; thresholds unchanged.
Single checks module holding the five tests and the aggregator; unit U4 merged into U3; content.py with a sync test.
CI also runs on Windows.
Removed referenced_by entries, which only repeated the forward refs in reverse; they can be regenerated from the ref entries.
All repository text, specification prose, READMEs and prompts are in English; the conversation with the owner is in Portuguese.
Broken quoting in the ledger (an unclosed quote, or text after a closing quote) makes the whole file unreadable: code 2. It silently swallowed rows or altered values before.
More rows than one Excel sheet can hold stops the run with a new error and code 1, instead of losing rows with no warning.
A line with only spaces counts as a blank line in the ledger, as it already did in the holidays file.

spec.last_check: Official checker unavailable; network marked unverified; own script check of version 0.2 done (XML parse, unique ids, every ref resolves).
